knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The procedure says to read the service type, included areas, exclusions and special instructions before work. Client requests on the day do not change the order.
The worked decision declines the unapproved change politely and refers it for formal approval. Requests are documented neutrally.
Completion is judged against the work order. Unapproved extra work and photos of private documents are the errors the lesson names.

practicalCriteria: Learner states the included and excluded tasks for a supplied work order before starting.
Learner identifies from a supplied work order any task that is not clearly included, records it as a variation and does not start it without approval.
Learner records a supplied unclear instruction, the designated contact's answer and the time it was given before starting work.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Job record showing included tasks and the completion of each
Record of any variation request, the approver and the time of the answer
Record of any incomplete task and the reason
stopWorkCriteria: Learner starts a task that is not clearly included and has no approval
Learner marks a job complete when included tasks were not done
